info.name: NetLedger v4.0.0
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman collection for testing the NetLedger.Server and NetLedger Archive Server REST APIs.

## Variables
- `{{protocol}}` - HTTP or HTTPS (default: http)
- `{{hostname}}` - Server hostname (default: localhost)
- `{{port}}` - NetLedger Server port (default: 8080)
- `{{archivePort}}` - NetLedger Archive Server port (default: 8081)
- `{{apiKey}}` - Bearer token or credential access key for authentication
- `{{tenantId}}` - Tenant identifier (Docker default: default)
- `{{accountId}}` - Account identifier, usually captured from account creation/enumeration
- `{{entryId}}` - Entry identifier, usually captured from entry creation/enumeration
- `{{manifestId}}`, `{{archiveObjectId}}`, `{{migrationId}}`, and `{{batchId}}` - Archive identifiers captured from archive requests

## Credential Setup
The server generates a random admin credential on first run if none is configured. Check the server console for: `created default admin credential: nlk_...`

Alternatively, set `DefaultAdminKey` in your server settings before starting. Docker development defaults use `netledgeradmin`.

## v4.0.0 Archive Contract
NetLedger Server remains active-only. Archive reads and archive metadata management are handled by NetLedger Archive Server. Use separate active and archive base URLs; responses include `x-netledger-data-scope` to identify active versus archive data.
